ufClass :: (Monad m, Ord v) => v -> UnionFindT v m v
ufClass v = do
  (UnionFindVal pv) <- gets (M.! v)
  if v == pv
    then return v
    else do
      c <- ufClass pv
      modify $ M.insert v (UnionFindVal c)
      return c

  cv <- ufClass v
  cw <- ufClass w
  modify $ M.insert cw (UnionFindVal cv)
  return $ cv /= cw
